data.title: 橘美花莉 · 摄影棚收工的三秒
data.description: 摄影棚白色背景前，闪光灯刚停，她从完美表情切换到松一口气的真实脸只用三秒；工作人员围着看片，她独自拿起水杯，眼神飘向手机里的社团群消息。
data.action: 摄影棚白色背景前，闪光灯刚停，她从完美表情切换到松一口气的真实脸只用三秒
data.promptProse: As the studio lights settle after a fashion photograph, popular teen fashion model Mikari lowers her practiced smile into a relieved natural expression and lifts a paper cup of water. Her vibrant pink eyes drift toward a phone showing a message from Okumura. Her long light chestnut brown hair is parted off-center with strands falling between her eyes, the upper strands gathered into two-side-up bunches tied with delicate pink ribbons, framing her youthful face as her chic off-the-shoulder blouse and pink skirt catch the soft studio glow. A close view includes the edge of the white backdrop and a light stand, revealing the quiet instant between professional performance and personal longing.
